routes.definition: Product of two alpha-weighted value means minus sum_t alpha_t^2*x_t*y_t. Collision-mass control multiplies the product by 1-sum alpha^2.

routes.comparison: Input/word-state pair alignment is not this value readout. It authorizes neither changing pairs nor reviving the stopped screen.

routes.scope: Pinned original attempt exit1, mixed Float/Double; no completed efficacy outcome in this pinned execution. Do not convert technical failure into a valid negative.
routes.comparison: The proposed statistic does not whiten states or alter any output. Frame spectrum alone does not identify its input-pair coupling.

routes.scope: Zero-update diagnosis, not a trained intervention or a failed semantic-query method.
